title: Design System: BWH Lab
scope: Landing page experiments under /lab only. The blog pages are out of scope.

desk-blue.note: Dark theme resolves to a light blue with dark ink-base text; the intake field overrides to surface-blue-2 in dark.

ink-meta.note: lab.css lifts frappe-ui ink-gray-5 inside .lab and .lab-chrome for WCAG AA (4.5:1).

display.purpose: The single H1 per variant; 36–40px on phones rising to 52–68px; balance-wrapped, 15–18ch.

headline.purpose: Closing intake heading and theory-of-change stage panels; 28px rising to 34px.

title.purpose: Section titles inside the MIS report.

title-sm.purpose: Panel-header titles, row names, the BWH wordmark.

lede.purpose: First-viewport ledes and section intros, 48–64ch; 17–18px at 1.6 from sm on MIS and theory of change.

body.purpose: Paragraphs inside panels and the funder strip.

label.purpose: Field labels, KPI labels, legends, breadcrumbs and meta, in Ink Meta. Sentence case.

data-kpi.purpose: KPI numerals that count up; 28px on phones, 34px from sm.

data.purpose: Numbers, IDs, dates, cell references and formulas only; 11–13px.

shadows.name: raised-item
shadows.purpose: Current sidebar item, focused text field, mobile View tray.

shadows.name: lifted-node
shadows.purpose: Theory-of-change chain node on hover, with a -2px lift.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: Lab switcher and its menu; the chip ghost that flies into the intake window.

shadows.name: stage-panel
shadows.purpose: Theory-of-change walk panels over the tinted stage.

shadows.name: app-window
shadows.purpose: The Your system window on the intake blue field.

motion.name: lab-ease
motion.purpose: The one curve for every entrance, scrub and state change (--lab-ease in CSS, EASE_OUT in motion.ts).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour, border and transform changes on buttons, chips, links.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Entrance of revealed elements, only under html[data-motion=on].

motion.name: preview-swap
motion.purpose: Intake app window switching between module previews.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: KPI numerals; restores the exact server text on completion.

motion.name: stage-tint
motion.purpose: Theory-of-change walk backdrop changing to the stage colour.

motion.name: live-breath
motion.purpose: Live dot halo; three breaths then still.

motion.name: map-ripple
motion.purpose: MIS map pin ripples; three then still.

motion.name: motion-gate
motion.value: html[data-motion=on], stamped before paint, removed after 2500ms if the script never boots
motion.purpose: The only condition under which content may start hidden. Reduced motion never sets it.

components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; } .ds-chip-input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-chip-face { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-gray-2, oklch(0.913 0 0)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-base, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--ink-gray-7, oklch(0.341 0 0)); font: 420 13px/1.5 InterVar, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.015em; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover .ds-chip-face { border-color: var(--outline-gray-3, oklch(0.83 0 0)); color: var(--ink-gray-9, oklch(0.168 0 0)); } .ds-chip:active .ds-chip-face { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-chip-input:checked + .ds-chip-face { border-color: var(--outline-blue-3, oklch(0.88 0.061 242.553)); background: var(--surface-blue-2, oklch(0.96 0.021 241.348)); color: var(--ink-blue-8, oklch(0.477 0.149 253.403)); } .ds-chip-input:focus-visible + .ds-chip-face { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--surface-base, oklch(1 0 0)), 0 0 0 3px var(--outline-blue-4, oklch(0.73 0.121 245.297)); } .ds-chip-icon { position: relative; width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-chip-icon svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; transition: opacity 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-chip-check svg { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); } .ds-chip-input:checked + .ds-chip-face .ds-chip-plus { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-chip-input:checked + .ds-chip-face .ds-chip-check svg { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

narrative.overview:
Each page is a working instrument from a nonprofit's own office: the programme dashboard (MIS), the beneficiary spreadsheet, the theory of change and logframe, the helpdesk request form. The visitor reads our work in a format they already fill in every week. Every instrument is drawn in Frappe's desk language: grey work surfaces, hairline-bordered panels, small-type chrome, deep-blue actions, and numbers in a monospace face. The tool's own chrome (top bar, sidebar, formula bar, sheet tabs, ticket header) is the page's navigation. It is not decoration.

The density is a working tool's density, not a brochure's: 12 to 14px chrome, 44 to 48px bars, 8 to 16px gaps inside panels. The display headline is the one loud thing in each first viewport. Colour is semantic. Blue means act or "your system", violet means training and our home, and green means live. Missing facts stay visible as dashed TBD chips, never as invented filler.

Motion explains the transformation the page argues for. Arcs draw out from Jagdalpur, the sheet resolves into a list, the results chain draws itself, and the system assembles as problems are picked. Content is visible by default. Motion only runs when a flag says it may.
keyCharacteristics: Frappe desk chrome as page structure: bars, sidebars, tabs and panels at their real-tool dimensions.
Flat panels on 1px hairlines; shadow only on things that float.
Two accents with fixed meanings (blue action, violet training), plus green for live state only.
Inter for words, Geist Mono for numbers, IDs, dates and formulas.
Visible TBD chips where partner-supplied content is missing.
Exponential ease-out motion gated by a pre-paint flag, with a reduced-motion path for every scene.

rules.name: The Green Means Live Rule
rules.body: Green appears only for live, in-use, visited or sent state. It never decorates, and it is never a stage colour: the theory of change draws Impact in pink so green keeps its single meaning.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Blue is action and the visitor's system; violet is training, learning, AI and our home in Jagdalpur. Amber, red, cyan and pink are status or stage signals, never a third brand accent.

rules.name: The Lifted Meta Rule
rules.body: On lab pages `ink-gray-5` is lifted to `oklch(0.52 0 0)` in light and `oklch(0.63 0 0)` in dark, past 4.5:1, by `.lab` and `.lab-chrome` in `lab.css`. It is the lightest ink for readable text; `ink-gray-4` and `ink-gray-3` are for icons and separators only.

rules.name: The Stage Palette Rule
rules.body: A results chain uses six stages in a fixed order: amber Problem, grey Inputs, blue Activities, cyan Outputs, violet Outcomes, pink Impact. Each stage uses its `-2` band, `-1` tint, `-7` dot and `-8` ink, and these colours stay inside the theory-of-change world.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for numbers, IDs, dates, cell references and formulas only, always with tabular figures. Words, including metadata values that are prose, stay in Inter.

rules.name: The One Loud Line Rule
rules.body: Each first viewport has one display-size line. Everything else in the chrome stays at product sizes (12–14px) so the page still reads as a tool.

rules.name: The Real Chrome Rule
rules.body: Bars, sidebars, tabs and rows keep the dimensions of the tool they imitate (48px top bar, 14rem sidebar, 44px panel head, 30px sheet row, 36px tab bar). They are navigation that works, not ornament.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Panels are flat at rest and separated by hairlines. A shadow means the element floats above the page (switcher, app window, flying chip ghost) or answers a pointer or focus state.

rules.name: The Visible By Default Rule
rules.body: Content renders visible. A hidden starting state exists only under `html[data-motion='on']`, and every scene must read completely without its script.

rules.name: The Three Breaths Rule
rules.body: Ambient loops (live dot, map ripples) run three times and stop. A loop that never ends is noise.

dos: **Do** use frappe-ui semantic tokens (`surface-*`, `ink-*`, `outline-*`) for every colour, so the light and dark themes flip together.
**Do** put primary actions in Desk Blue (`surface-blue-9`) with `ink-base` text, 32px or 40px high, with 8px or 10px corners.
**Do** separate panels with 1px Hairline borders and 44px panel headers instead of shadows.
**Do** set numbers, IDs, dates and formulas in `font-data` (Geist Mono, tabular figures).
**Do** mark missing partner content with the dashed TBD chip, saying what is missing.
**Do** draw icons with Lucide through the `Icon` component at 1.75 stroke, 14–16px.
**Do** gate entrance motion on `data-motion`, use the `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` ease, and give every scene a reduced-motion path.
donts: **Don't** use green for anything except live, in-use, visited or sent state.
**Don't** set words or prose in Geist Mono.
**Don't** use stock `ink-gray-5` outside `.lab`, or `ink-gray-4` and lighter, for readable text.
**Don't** add a third accent; amber, red, cyan and pink are status or stage signals only.
**Don't** put a small label above a heading as an eyebrow, use gradient text, add coloured side-stripe borders to cards, or use Unicode glyphs as icons.
**Don't** hide content in CSS unless the motion flag is on, and don't run ambient loops forever.
**Don't** add shadows to panels at rest.
